segments.he: גְּמָ׳ תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: חָכָם בְּנוֹ — שׁוֹאֲלוֹ. וְאִם אֵינוֹ חָכָם — אִשְׁתּוֹ שׁוֹאַלְתּוֹ, וְאִם לָאו — הוּא שׁוֹאֵל לְעַצְמוֹ, וַאֲפִילּוּ שְׁנֵי תַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים שֶׁיּוֹדְעִין בְּהִלְכוֹת הַפֶּסַח — שׁוֹאֲלִין זֶה לָזֶה.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» «The Sages taught:» If «his son is wise» and knows how to inquire, his son «asks him. And if he is not wise, his wife asks him. And if» even his wife is «not» capable of asking or if he has no wife, «he asks himself. And even» if «two Torah scholars who know the halakhot of Passover» are sitting together and there is no one else present to pose the questions, they «ask each other.»

moves.summary: son asks; else wife; else himself; even two scholars ask each other
